screening_decisions.reason: Randomized controlled trial in women with stress UI; PFMT (with/without biofeedback) versus a no-exercise control arm meets PFMT vs inactive control.
Randomized controlled trial in women with SUI; intervention delivered via mobile app promoting PFMT versus postponed treatment (inactive/waitlist).
Randomized controlled trial in postmenopausal women with SUI; PFME alone or with biofeedback compared with a control group (no treatment).
Randomized trial in older women with urge/mixed UI including a placebo control; behavioral treatment is biofeedback-assisted (PFMT not explicit) so included conservatively.
Randomized controlled trial in older women with sphincteric incompetence (stress UI) comparing pelvic muscle exercises and biofeedback to a control group.
Stratified single-blind RCT in women with genuine SUI; PFMT versus electrical stimulation, vaginal cones, and a no-treatment control arm.
Randomized experimental study in women with SUI; perineal/pelvic floor exercises versus control.
Single-blind randomized controlled trial in women with urodynamic SUI; PFMT, ES, and cones versus no active treatment (control).
Prospective randomized controlled clinical trial in women with stress/mixed UI; PFMT versus control.
Randomized controlled trial in women with UI; behavioral modification program versus no treatment. PFMT content not explicit but pelvic muscle strength improved—include conservatively.

Prospective randomized study comparing active physical therapy modalities (e.g., medical gymnastics vs perineal electrical stimulation) without a clearly described inactive/no-treatment control or explicit PFMT vs inactive comparison.
Randomized crossover trial in elderly women with SUI; intervention includes pelvic floor muscle and fitness exercises versus control.
Randomized trial in elderly women with UI; exercise ± heat/steam vs HSGS only vs education control. PFMT not explicit but exercise likely includes pelvic floor components—include conservatively.
Randomized controlled trial in elderly women with stress/urge/mixed UI; multidimensional exercise treatment versus control. PFMT not explicit—include conservatively.
Randomized controlled trial in older women with UI; standardized physiotherapy program includes pelvic floor muscle training versus advice/pamphlet control (inactive).
Randomized study in women with SUI; physiotherapist-supervised PFMT versus no treatment control.
Prospective randomized single-blind study in women with mild-to-moderate SUI; instruction in pelvic floor precontraction ('The Knack') versus waitlist control—PFMT-related skill training.
Randomized controlled pilot study in women with SUI; PFMT delivered in group or individual format versus no treatment control.
Randomized pilot trial in women with mixed UI; includes a PFMT arm and a waiting list control arm.

Randomized controlled trial in postmenopausal women with UI; physical therapy for UI (content not fully specified, likely includes PFMT) versus osteoporosis education control (inactive for UI)—included conservatively.
Study comparing bladder training vs pelvic muscle exercises with a control group in women with UI; includes PFMT and inactive control.
Randomized experimental study in women with stress UI; kinesitherapy (exercise) ± electrical stimulation versus control; pelvic floor muscle function assessed—PFMT likely included.
Randomized experimental study in female volleyball athletes with urinary leakage; PF muscle rehabilitation program versus pamphlet control (inactive).
Random allocation to pelvic floor exercises, interferential therapy, estrogen, or control in women with genuine stress incontinence; includes PFMT versus inactive control.
Randomized controlled trial in general practice; pelvic floor exercises versus no therapy in women with stress UI.
Parallel-group RCT in adult women with stress/mixed UI; PFMT arm vs untreated control (inactive). Meets population, PFMT intervention, inactive comparator, and randomized design.
Pragmatic RCT of nurse specialist involvement vs usual care; organizational care model, not PFMT vs inactive control.
RCT evaluating satisfaction with nurse specialist vs GP care; not testing PFMT vs inactive control.
Behavioral training with/without biofeedback vs self-help booklet; all arms active behavioral/PFMT elements; no inactive comparator.
Feasibility study without clear randomization; group classes/education; not a randomized/quasi-randomized PFMT vs inactive trial.
Supervised vs unsupervised PFMT; both arms active PFMT; no inactive control.
RCT in women with chronic low back pain and stress UI; control receives routine physiotherapy/exercises (active), not an inactive comparator to PFMT.
Behavioral training ± pelvic floor electrical stimulation vs self-help booklet; all active behavioral treatments; no inactive control.
Randomized trial in elderly women with UI; program includes Kegel’s (PFMT) vs control group. PFMT present; control likely inactive/usual care from abstract. Include at title/abstract stage.

Randomized trial in adult women with UI comparing behavioral therapy vs no therapy; behavioral UI therapy often includes PFMT though not explicit here. Comparator is no therapy (inactive). Include conservatively.
Economic evaluation alongside RCT comparing Internet vs postal PFMT; both trial arms active PFMT; no inactive control.
Internet-based vs postal PFMT RCT; active vs active; no inactive comparator.
1- and 2-year results from Internet vs postal PFMT RCT; active vs active; no inactive comparator.

Pilot RCT in frail older women; intervention includes behavioral UI treatments plus physical activity; PFMT not explicit but commonly part of behavioral UI strategies; comparator present. Include conservatively.
RCT in gynecologic cancer survivors with pelvic floor dysfunction; UI not specified as required condition; population does not match adult women with UI per protocol.
